description: Stage-3 10-second concrete-block bonus stage (0x41fe6..0x422b8): Ryu breaks all four block stacks (0x18ea4 +1,000 at 32498, 0x18e84 +3,000 at 32563, 0x18e64 +1,000 at 32678, 0x18e44 +3,000 at 32743), triggering the 8,000-point 0x3baf6 early exit at 32744 and advancing via 0x3efc4 to stage 4 (Thailand) at 33017.

reference.notes: US set 1, six-button controls; MAME set sf. ROM set verified by mame -verifyroms against the pinned build.

machine.dipswitches: factory defaults; observed readback DSW1=0xdfff, DSW2=0xffff

inputs.comment: insert coin; title screen is up from ~1375
confirm default country Japan at country select (visible by ~1860)
bonus-1 plank break press (power 10, success branch 0x410b6-0x41220)
bonus-2 stone break press (power 10, success branch 0x41d8c-0x41eda)
crouching HP (mv 0x1c): breaks lower-right stack (0x18ea4, +1,000) at frame 32498
jump HP (mv 0x21): breaks upper-right stack (0x18e84, +3,000) at frame 32563
turn left and walk left to left clamp (cx=0xc0)
crouching HP (mv 0x1c): breaks lower-left stack (0x18e64, +1,000) at frame 32678
jump HP (mv 0x21): breaks upper-left stack (0x18e44, +3,000) at frame 32743
